title: Choose the home composition
question: Door Clipboard is locked. Which first-viewport composition should we build? The sheet list is the decision-round north star; the other two vary topology and hierarchy inside the same world.

options.label: The sheet
options.thesis: Tonight is one paper guest list: time, title, venue, door, highlighter on I'm going.
options.viewport: Full-width paper sheet under a clip. Rows. First row larger. Find on the masthead.
options.risk: Can flatten into a table if the paper and clip are not built as material.

options.label: List and plan
options.thesis: Tonight's list and My Weekend sit as two sheets on the same clipboard.
options.viewport: Left: tonight's rows. Right: My Weekend gathered by Fri/Sat/Sun from highlighted names.
options.risk: Desktop-only; the second sheet must collapse on the phone, not shrink.

options.label: Time rail
options.thesis: Hours are the spine; nights hang off 21:00 / 22:00 / 23:00 on the same paper.
options.viewport: Clipboard masthead, then a vertical time rail with nights to the right of each hour.
options.risk: Over-indexes when and underplays venue photos on home.
